It's like the Hypixel Pit!}} |} === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} == Tips == *It is recommended to use Black color to maximize the stat buffs from the '''Leggings of the Coven''', as it is what the majority of players have informally agreed to use. == Trivia == *The White variant is one of 6 armor pieces which have the hex color code of {{Color Display|#FFFFFF}}.
